text: たびを　たのしんで　おるようじゃな　レッドの　ことじゃ　もっと　いろいろな　ところに　でかけて　いくんじゃろう　よきかな　よきかな……　ほっほっほ

structure.jp: たびを　たのしんで　おるようじゃな
structure.en: you seem to be enjoying your journey

structure.jp: レッドの　ことじゃ
もっと　いろいろな　ところに　でかけて　いくんじゃろう
structure.en: you'll surely go on to many more places

structure.jp: よきかな　よきかな……

patterns.name: 〜のことだ
patterns.span: レッドの　ことじゃ
patterns.explanation: A person plus のことだ means 'knowing what that person is like', and what follows is what you expect of them; じゃ is the old-man だ. レッドの　ことじゃ = 'knowing you, Red'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: たのしんで　おるようじゃ
patterns.explanation: ようだ says 'it seems that', a guess from what you can see; おる and じゃ are the old-man ways of saying いる and だ. たのしんで　おるようじゃ = 'it seems you're enjoying it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだろう
patterns.span: でかけて　いくんじゃろう
patterns.explanation: のだろう at the end says 'I expect that', a confident guess; じゃろう is the old-man way of saying だろう. でかけて　いくんじゃろう = 'I expect you'll keep heading out'.
